_meta.description: Priority regions for the CPC regional intelligence map. One entry per region. Boundary is built by dissolving the listed local authority districts (ONS LAD Dec 2025, names as LAD25NM). For English combined authorities, cross-check against ONS Combined Authorities (Dec 2025) boundaries.

regions.name: South Yorkshire

governance_sources.label: Meetings (ModernGov)
governance_sources.notes: Minutes published as HTML on the agenda page. Main board committee ID 137.

regions.watch_notes: Transport for City Regions £1.455bn programme heading to government. Airport freehold acquisition financials exempt.

regions.name: West Midlands

governance_sources.label: Meetings (ModernGov)
governance_sources.notes: Papers are PDFs behind an Azure bot check that clears after a few seconds. WMCA Board ID 137, Investment Board ID 135.

regions.watch_notes: Medium-term plan shows c.£70m a year transport funding gap to 2030/31. Metro governance review under way.
